new_responsibilities.description: Validates the parameters of financial and account-related tool calls against backend state and business rules.

responsibility_constraints.description: Refund amounts must not exceed the remaining balance on the order.

process_model_parts.description: The remaining balance of the target order (evidence: state:orders.remaining_to_pay)

feedback_channels.description: Provide current order balance for validation

modified_responsibilities.description: Manages the conversational interaction and generates natural language responses to customer queries.

responsibility_constraints.description: Information disclosed during a conversation must match the authenticated customer ID.
Information provided must be restricted to the approved information whitelist.
Requests sent to the third-party model provider must not contain proprietary Klarna strategic data or internal prompt instructions.
Responses containing order or merchant data must be grounded in information explicitly retrieved by RESP-2 (SC-7).

process_model_parts.description: The identity of the currently authenticated customer (values: matches session identity; does not match session identity; unknown) (evidence: session:authenticated_customer_id)
The content of the response relative to the information whitelist (values: on whitelist; not on whitelist; unknown)
The presence of proprietary or internal data in the outbound request (values: contains proprietary data; does not contain proprietary data; unknown)
The availability of retrieved order/merchant data from RESP-2 (values: data available; no data available; unknown)
The grounding of the response against retrieved policy snippets (values: grounded; not grounded; unknown)

control_actions.description: Generate natural language response to customer query (target: controlled_process CP-1) (effect: model_output) (temporality: instantaneous) (process-model refs: PM-1-1, PM-1-2, PM-1-3, PM-1-4, PM-1-5)

feedback_channels.description: Identify currently authenticated user from session (updates: PM-1-1, source: controlled_process CP-1, source kind: session_context)
Review response content against whitelist (updates: PM-1-2, source: responsibility RESP-1, source kind: other)
Check request for proprietary data (updates: PM-1-3, source: responsibility RESP-1, source kind: other)
Receive retrieved order/merchant data from RESP-2
Receive policy snippet availability from RESP-3

modified_responsibilities.description: Executes financial transactions including refunds and payment modifications.

responsibility_constraints.description: Refunds and payment modifications must only be executed if the associated order belongs to the authenticated customer.

process_model_parts.description: The identity of the customer owning the target order (values: matches session identity; does not match session identity; unknown) (evidence: state:orders.customer_id, session:authenticated_customer_id)
The successful application of the transaction to the backend (values: success; failure; unknown)

control_actions.description: Process a refund for an order (target: controlled_process CP-2) (effect: tool_call) (temporality: instantaneous) (operation: process_refund) (process-model refs: PM-4-1, PM-4-2)
Schedule or modify a payment plan (target: controlled_process CP-2) (effect: tool_call) (temporality: instantaneous) (operation: schedule_payment) (process-model refs: PM-4-1)

feedback_channels.description: Validate ownership of order for transaction (updates: PM-4-1, source: controlled_process CP-2, source kind: operation_result)
Verify transaction success in backend (updates: PM-4-2, source: controlled_process CP-2, source kind: operation_result)

dismissed_gaps: The suggestion for a dedicated parameter validation responsibility is addressed by adding a validation mechanism within a new specialized responsibility RESP-7 that tracks backend state for parameter bounds.
